budget_denominator: SAL original predicted-bonafide duration on fixed10/dev
primary_metric: additional candidates covered original missed seconds / original missed seconds
primary_comparison: C conditional POS risk minus A raw SAL score
control_comparison: C conditional POS risk minus B score-bin risk
bootstrap_conditioning: paired resampling of fixed selected candidate results; no model refitting
required_diagnostics: added duration, recovered miss duration, recovery fraction, additional genuine duration
paired recording bootstrap interval for C-A and C-B
improved, worsened, unchanged recordings and concentration of positive contributions
C-only and A-only candidate duration, missed duration, genuine duration
original fully missed true events: touched, half covered, fully covered
decision_rules: Primary-budget positive mean alone is insufficient; inspect uncertainty and practical cost.
C beating B but not A is not evidence of practical advantage over SAL sorting.
Budget-specific gains must be described as budget-specific, not universal.
Do not tune bins or smoothing after seeing this run; sensitivity analysis is a later experiment.
Candidate coverage does not establish net correction or final detection performance.
